exercises.question: Choose the grammar pattern that matches: "How about...?".

options.text: A とか B とか
A は B ほど～ありません
A は B ほど～ない
~たら いかがですか

exercises.correctFeedback: Great! ~たら いかがですか matches "How about...?".
exercises.incorrectFeedback: Not quite. The correct pattern is ~たら いかがですか.
exercises.explanation: Polite way to suggest or recommend an action if a condition is met.

exercises.question: Choose the correct meaning for: ~たら いかがですか.
